summary: Diff adds a new Motoko backend actor and a React/TanStack Router frontend with Home, Post Detail, and Admin pages, Internet Identity login controls, allowlist management UI, media upload/gallery components, and a warm charcoal/cream theme with paper texture background. However, several backend data/authorization and API-shape requirements from the BuildRequest are not evidenced in the diff summary (notably stable persistence, timestamps/fields, pagination, and owner-constant logic).

missing_requirements.requirement: Posts are persisted in the canister and survive reloads/upgrades using stable storage patterns.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend diff shows in-memory vars/maps/sets (`var nextPostId`, `let posts = Map.empty...`, `let entitledUsers = Set.empty...`) but no stable variables or `preupgrade`/`postupgrade` logic is visible in the provided `backend/main.mo` excerpt.

missing_requirements.requirement: Each post includes at minimum: id, title, body text, createdAt timestamp, updatedAt timestamp, isLocked boolean, and media attachments.
missing_requirements.reason: The shown `Post` type lacks `updatedAt`, and the internal `PostData` shown does not store `title` at all. Also `createdAt` is set to `Nat64.fromNat(postId)` (not a timestamp).

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend exposes a query for listing posts with pagination parameters and a query for fetching a single post by id.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend calls `actor.getAllPosts()` with no pagination args, suggesting the listing API is not paginated. No evidence of pagination parameters is shown in backend excerpt.

missing_requirements.requirement: Owner identity is determined by caller principal and a configured owner principal constant (document where to set it).
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend initializes admin access via a secret URL parameter (`caffeineAdminToken`) and calls `_initializeAccessControlWithSecret(adminToken)`; backend uses an `AccessControl` permission check, but no configured owner principal constant/documentation is evidenced in the shown backend excerpt.

hallucinated_features.description: User profile management APIs (get/save user profiles) requiring a #user permission.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not mention user profiles; scope is single-author posts with II-gated locked content and allowlist entitlements.

hallucinated_features.description: Secret-token-based admin initialization via URL parameter (`caffeineAdminToken`) and `_initializeAccessControlWithSecret`.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest specifies owner is determined by caller principal and a configured owner principal constant; it does not request an admin secret token mechanism passed via URL params.
